launch_evidence.quote: In the last two weeks, we have received US approvals for Cervarix, Votrient and Arzerra.

series_start_reason: FDA approval 26 Oct 2009 (2009Q4). GSK's Q4 2009 announcement (0000950123-10-008661) prints no Arzerra turnover row; the first row is Q1 2010 (5). No GSK document states a launch date in words; launch_quarter is the US approval quarter, one quarter before the first printed row.
series_end_reason: GSK sold its oncology business (Arzerra included) to Novartis on 2 March 2015; GSK's Q1 2015 announcement (0001191638-15-000622) prints no brand rows. Novartis prints Arzerra only in pipeline tables (Q1 2015 to Q1 2018 reports), never a sales row. The last row is GSK's Q4 2014 (12; 2014 54).
notes: GSK plc worldwide turnover in GBP millions, Total column of the quarterly Pharmaceuticals turnover table (the same row prints USA, Europe and other-region columns).
search_log: Listed GSK plc (CIK 1131399) filings via data.sec.gov submissions (6,852 filings, 6,139 of them 6-K); located the quarterly results announcements with EDGAR full-text search for 'Tykerb', 'Votrient' and 'Arzerra' (6-K hits 2007-2015 in the results windows; 39 documents fetched).

The quarter's figure is read from the Pharmaceuticals turnover table headed 'Three months ended ...' (the cumulative 'Six/Nine months ended' and 'Year ended' tables are skipped); the period comes from that heading. Re-filed copies (2008-05-06, 2012-05-02) are not cited; the earlier filing is.

GSK's Q1 2015 results announcement (6-K 0001191638-15-000622, gsk201505066k.htm) prints no oncology brand rows: 'Oncology sales for the first two months were £216 million', after the disposal of the oncology business to Novartis on 2 March 2015.
Arzerra checks: 2010 31 (5+8+9+9), 2011 44, 2012 60, 2013 75, 2014 54, each equal to the year figure of the Q4 announcement.
Novartis interim reports 2015-2026 searched by script: 'Arzerra' rows are pipeline entries only.
